nonblocking_findings: P3C4-1 [Nit] review-c: review-score.ts:87 and :171 still accept any YYYY-MM-DD text, including an impossible calendar date such as 2026-02-31, and write it into the score file; guide.ts then refuses the pass and preview.sh drops the Code review row. Rationale: the producer accepts what its consumer refuses. Fix: validate the calendar date in review-score.ts, or let guide.ts skip the pass.

P3C4-2 [Nit] review-c: the verdicts, judge, queue, and score-file parses are guarded, but the key-file parses stay unguarded: adjudicate.ts:298, review-score.ts:324 and :476 call JSON.parse on a key file with no guard, so one malformed key still ends the run with an uncaught exception, exit 1, and a stack trace. Rationale: the same private input has two different failure contracts. Fix: wrap the key parses and refuse with queue: key and score: key.

P3C4-3 [Nit] review-c: harness/model-guide/review-prompt.md:12-15 still says each line starts with its new-side number and a line that starts with a number and a space is a context line, but every body line starts with L (review-set.ts:84 BODY_RE) and a context line is L<n>, one space, the kind space, and the text. Rationale: the D10 input misdescribes the diff format it consumes. Fix: describe the kind character after the number.

P3C4-4 [Nit] review-c: review-set.ts:77 and review-score.ts:80 still default --sets and --scores to repo-root-relative harness/model-guide/data/... while every documented command runs from harness/, so the defaults resolve to harness/harness/model-guide/data/... that no consumer reads; a run that omits the flag then writes where no consumer looks and the Code review row stays no pick yet. Rationale: an omitted flag silently targets an unread folder. Fix: require the flags or resolve the defaults against the repository root.
